data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (search, open restaurant, optionally set date and guests, click Notify, set the preferred time and confirm) and covers the parameters, but it adds optional city and meal parameters and is a bit vague about which restaurant to open and how the time window is set, though a browser automation could still be built from it.
